target.title: fix(mattermost): cap opaque, outbound, and monitor resource caches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Mattermost gateways running for extended periods under high-cardinality traffic accumulate unbounded in-process lookup Maps. Six Maps across three files have no eviction path:

- `mattermostOpaqueTargetCache` (`target-resolution.ts`) — one entry per distinct `{baseUrl, token, opaqueId}` triple, never evicted
- `botUserCache`, `userByNameCache`, `channelByNameCache`, `dmChannelCache` (`send.ts`) — four outbound send-path Maps, zero eviction
- `channelCache`, `userCache` (`monitor-resources.ts`) — TTL-bounded per-value but no entry-count cap

On a busy multi-team instance a gateway can see tens of thousands of distinct users and channel IDs. All six Maps grow monotonically until the process restarts.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` after every cache-set call. Each Map uses LRU refresh (delete-then-reinsert before capping) so recently used keys survive eviction. Named `cacheMattermostOpaqueTarget` and `cacheOutboundEntry` helpers are introduced to keep call sites uniform; `monitor-resources.ts` applies the cap inline inside `setCachedValue`.

| Cache | Cap | Location |
|---|---|---|
| `mattermostOpaqueTargetCache` | 1 024 | `target-resolution.ts` |
| `botUserCache` | 256 | `send.ts` |
| `userByNameCache` | 1 024 | `send.ts` |
| `channelByNameCache` | 1 024 | `send.ts` |
| `dmChannelCache` | 1 024 | `send.ts` |
| `channelCache` (monitor) | 1 000 | `monitor-resources.ts` |
| `userCache` (monitor) | 1 000 | `monitor-resources.ts` |

Caps match the existing Slack plugin precedent (`SLACK_DM_CHANNEL_CACHE_MAX = 1024`).

## User Impact

Operators running Mattermost channels on long-lived gateways get predictable, bounded memory for all in-process lookup caches. Send and monitor behavior is unchanged for normal workloads; only the oldest cached entries are evicted under sustained high-cardinality traffic.

## Evidence

**Diff:** 5 files changed, +123 / −12 lines

**Two new regression tests, both passing on `fix/mattermost-cap-process-caches`:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-mattermost.config.ts \
    extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/target-resolution.test.ts \
    extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-resources.test.ts \
    --reporter=verbose

 ✓ mattermost monitor resources > caches channel and user lookups and falls back to empty picker props  1ms
 ✓ mattermost monitor resources > evicts oldest channel cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap    2ms
 ✓ mattermost monitor resources > does not reuse cached lookups while the process clock is invalid      0ms
 ✓ mattermost target resolution > recognizes explicit targets and ID-shaped values                      1ms
 ✓ mattermost target resolution > resolves opaque ids as users and caches the result                   0ms
 ✓ mattermost target resolution > evicts oldest opaque target cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap  3ms

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
   Duration  3.85s
```

**Full extension-mattermost suite (42 test files, no regressions):**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-mattermost.config.ts

 Test Files  42 passed (42)
      Tests  525 passed (525)
   Duration  9.71s
```
